agent_turn_finished_check.name: agent_turn_finished_check
agent_turn_finished_check.value:
("agent_turn"."status" in ('pending', 'queued', 'running') and "agent_turn"."finished_at" is null)
    or ("agent_turn"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'stopped') and "agent_turn"."finished_at" is not null)

discourse_object_shape_check.name: discourse_object_shape_check
discourse_object_shape_check.value:
("discourse_object"."kind" = 'relation'
      and "discourse_object"."relation_type" is not null
      and "discourse_object"."subjects" is not null
      and "discourse_object"."objects" is not null
      and cardinality("discourse_object"."subjects") > 0
      and cardinality("discourse_object"."objects") > 0)
    or
    ("discourse_object"."kind" <> 'relation'
      and "discourse_object"."relation_type" is null
      and "discourse_object"."subjects" is null
      and "discourse_object"."objects" is null
      and "discourse_object"."body" is not null
      and length(trim("discourse_object"."body")) > 0)

excerpt_content_check.name: excerpt_content_check
excerpt_content_check.value: ("excerpt"."content" is not null and length(trim("excerpt"."content")) > 0) or "excerpt"."asset_path" is not null

message_author_check.name: message_author_check
message_author_check.value: ("message"."role" = 'user' and "message"."author_user_id" is not null) or ("message"."role" <> 'user' and "message"."author_user_id" is null)

source_payload_hash_check.name: source_payload_hash_check
source_payload_hash_check.value: ("source"."payload_path" is null and "source"."payload" is null) or "source"."content_hash" is not null

source_payload_media_type_check.name: source_payload_media_type_check
source_payload_media_type_check.value:
("source"."payload" is null and "source"."media_type" is null)
    or ("source"."payload" is not null and "source"."media_type" in ('application/pdf', 'text/plain'))
